title: feature-led-token-utilization-sensitivity-jun2025
content:
Purpose and scope:
- Quick working sheet + narrative for feature-led pricing sensitivity. Goal: show how feature adoption mix (chat, embeddings, rerank) changes unit economics and required HC/commitments across 3 pricing levers (hosted list price, reserved discount, burst overage).
- This is deliberately compact; use for 1:1 prep with product and ops next week.

Assumptions (working):
- Time horizon: 12 months (Jul2025 - Jun2026).
- Baseline customer mix: 58% chat, 30% embeddings, 12% rerank.
- Avg tokens per feature per active customer (month): chat=18k, embeddings=4k, rerank=1.5k.
- Avg price (hosted): $0.030 / 1k tokens (chat), $0.015 / 1k (embeddings), $0.080 / 1k (rerank).
- Reserved commit discount: 30% off hosted; burst overage = hosted * 1.35.
- GPU-backed serving unit cost: variable by model/quantization; translate to token-cost buckets (see table).

Key sensitivity table (monthly view, stress scenarios):
Columns: Scenario | MAU (k) | Avg tokens/MAU | Reserved commit (k tokens) | FTE hires (net) | Unit cost /1k tokens | Price /1k tokens | Gross margin
- Baseline | 14.2 | 12,500 | 120,000 | +6 | $0.012 | $0.028 weighted | 57%
- Low-demand | 11.0 | 10,800 | 90,000 | +2 | $0.013 | $0.028 weighted | 46%
- High-adopt | 18.5 | 15,300 | 180,000 | +12 | $0.010 | $0.030 weighted | 67%

Notes on numbers above: unit costs are blended across models (LlamaX-13B quantized + MPT-XXL fallback). Reserved commit reduces per-token backend cost via utilization smoothing; we model reserved commit as lowering unit cost by ~15-18% relative to on-demand at steady utilization.

Headcount plan (quarterly snapshot, hires targeted Jul-Dec 2025):
Role | Jul | Sep | Nov | Notes
- Capacity engineer | 1 | 2 | 3 | focus on batch/caching improvements (reduce cost by target 6-8%)
- Cost analytics PM | 0 | 1 | 1 | build per-route cost attribution in Console
- Enterprise AE (dedicated/private) | 2 | 3 | 4 | drives reserved commit deals
- Solutions SE | 1 | 2 | 2 | customer onboarding for high-token SKUs
- Total net new FTEs | 4 | 8 | 10 | ramped hiring cadence

Projected impact of hires (conservative estimates):
- Capacity engineering -> reduces backend unit cost by 0.5-1.1c per 1k tokens over 9 months
- Cost analytics PM -> enables re-pricing of 8% of mid-market customers into tiered plans
- Sales/SE -> converts 6–10% of trial ARR into reserved commitments (3–6 month effect)

Scenario sensitivity outputs (quick bullets):
- If average tokens/customer drops 15% (usage compression), runway impact: monthly gross margin down ~8 pts; hiring pause recommended if sustained >2 months.
- If reserved commit conversion increases from 10% to 20% of revenue: immediate reduction in short-term ARR but unit cost falls by ~12% -> net margin +6 pts in steady state.
- If price per 1k tokens increases by $0.004 (hosted list): elasticity observed in model = -0.18 => revenue uplift ~+6% but churn risk concentrated in smaller tiers.

Feature-tier experiments to prioritize (short list):
1) Early-access higher-price SKU for rerank-heavy customers (30% price premium, reserve discount stackable).
2) Volume step-discounts for embeddings-heavy startups (aggressive reserved commit messaging).
3) Per-route cost visibility in Console (pilot with 5 customers) to reduce negotiation friction.

Open questions / things to validate:
- [ ] Verify per-model token-cost mapping with infra (gpu/quantization assumptions).
- [ ] Get conversion lift estimates from sales ops for reserved commit messaging (empiric data).
- [ ] Check legal on tiered overage language for private deployments.

Quick action items (next 2 weeks):
- Leah: synthesize model-level cost sheet with infra (due 2025-06-20).
- Tom: draft short A/B test plan for rerank SKU pricing (due 2025-06-25).
- Anika: pull last 6 months MAU/token intensity by customer cohort (due 2025-06-22).

Appendix A — simplified monthly projection lines (example):
(Format: Month | MAU(k) | Weighted tokens per MAU | Total tokens (b) | Revenue ($k) | Backend cost ($k) | Gross margin)
- Jul-25 | 13.8 | 12.6k | 0.174 | 4,872 | 1,890 | 61%
- Aug-25 | 14.2 | 12.5k | 0.178 | 5,060 | 1,920 | 62%
- Sep-25 | 14.8 | 12.7k | 0.188 | 5,320 | 2,020 | 62%

Notes on appendix: token counts in billions (b) here are simplified — full sheet (linked) has per-feature breakout. Use these to eyeball runway impact under hiring and price moves.

Longer-term thinking (for later doc):
- Build a "reserve buffer" product: small monthly reserve that auto-scales to customer's 75th percentile usage, priced as blended reserved+burst. This could smooth both ops and conversion into committed revenue.

Hand-off / distribution:
- Share with product-hosted-api, eng-serving-runtime, and sales-ops. Use as deck base for Friday sync with DevRel and Solutions.

Working scratch notes (messy):
- if we can get kernel/compilation improvements -> per-token cost swing could be larger than hires in 9 months. flag as high upside.
- watch small-cohort churn (below $500/m) — price moves bite there.

End of working sheet.
